name: platinum-pack
_comment: restyle-back.cjs: the 151 back restyled to a graded front. Only the colours are per pack; the film level, sheen, grain and chroma are measured from the front by the tool.

palette._source: platinum-pack-front.webp. metal = median of the brightest 30% of the tier lettering box (150-780 x 1251-1352); pale = median of the brightest 25% of the logo box (285-550 x 540-855); dark = median of the darkest 10% of the body
palette._decision: Owner decision 2026-11-19: band and odds outline in the front's purple (median of the most chromatic 30% of its hue-330 pixels), dark ink; the neutral tier metal is variant "neutral".

filmMatch._comment: Platinum's body is a gunmetal film darker than its sheen bands: restyle-back.cjs lowers the film level to the front body's 25th-percentile L* (below the level the film scales with it, above it the sheen keeps its height).
